name: Full-Cap Crossed-Subcube Obstructions
statement: For the crossed base with $\alpha=1,\beta=0$, adjoining either full $U$-cap $\mathcal P_\epsilon(U)$ leaves a learning space, provided $V\ne\varnothing$ when $\epsilon=0$. The complementary endpoints $R=\{b,p\}\cup V$ and $\bar R=\{a,q\}\cup U$ are invalid roots with repair sets $\{a\}\cup V\cup(\{q\}	ext{ if }\epsilon=0)$ and $\{b,p,q\}\cup U$. Their pendant extension is contraction-minimal nonlearning of order $2^d-4\cdot2^{|U|}-2\cdot2^{|V|}+2$.
proof: For the zero cap, the deleted first wing and cap form one anchored subcube, making union closure and accessibility direct; the one cap is handled after translation. Exact rooted-union witnesses determine both hole sets, the neighbor test gives the displayed repair sets, and their union is all of $X$. Inclusion-exclusion gives the order.
